card.name: Contact details after 'for more information'
card.fires_on: The comma after a city in a mailing address, or a small word like 'at', 'to' or 'please', in a 'for more information, contact...' line just before a state, phone number or email.

modes.label: Comma after city
modes.description: The comma after a city name in a street address, right before the state abbreviation and ZIP code.
modes.example: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders National Institutes of Health 31 Center Drive, MSC 2320 Bethesda<<,>> MD 20892-

modes.label: Word before phone number
modes.description: A small word such as 'at', 'to' or 'please' after a contact request, just before a phone number or call-to action.
modes.example: For more information, contact Roger Hooks<< at>> (408) 61

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next piece of contact details, such as a state code or phone number.
card.plain: It fires in contact lines, such as the comma after a city in an address or the word 'at' before a phone number.
